community_list_entries.name: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces a benchmark for on-device long-term memory built from year-scale synthesized mobile user-app sessions. MobileMem-Omni has 16 users, about 202 sessions each, and 7,415 QA pairs covering single/multi-hop, knowledge update, temporal reasoning, implicit preference, abstention and visual reaso
